resolvedFindings.title: Scoped skill_graph_scan deletes every skill outside the scanned root and publishes the shrunken graph as live
CLI and hook fallback connect to a fixed /tmp socket without checking directory or socket ownership
Hook metrics store writes on every prompt into a shared temp folder with no owner, mode or symlink check, so another local user can redirect the append and chmod onto any victim-owned file
RRF fusion scores used as weighted sums in confidence and command penalty
Any slash in the prompt disables the skill-versus-command tie-break and breadth abstention
Returned ambiguous flag recomputed on the doctor-inclusive list
Low-information abstention counts stop words as meaningful tokens
Daemon trust gate is a caller assertion; shipped launcher makes missing assertion trusted against the server comment
Opt-in shadow sink appends raw prompts to a non-gitignored path without mode or symlink guard
Low-information and slash predicates hand-copied into the Python fallback with no shared fixture pinning them
Feature catalog presents supersession routing, rollback and v2 backfill as live behaviour, but only a stress test calls them
Contract-key header names consumers that do not exist
scoreAdvisorPrompt is a 366-line pipeline with no stage seam or ordering test
Pi adapter hard-copies the Claude hook budget with no guard test
Prompt cap and 0.82 confidence floors hard-coded in both TypeScript and Python
Gate-3 question lookup swallows a load failure
Corrupt-lock reclaim deletes a lock still being acquired
heldBelow names only the lowest holder, so a withheld holder leaves the held target free to make the top a coin flip
Local shared-payload copy names a drift watcher that does not exist, and the copies have already drifted
Python fallback hard-fails at import when the shared prompt-policy file is missing or malformed
A hardened writer turns silent on a platform where mode bits carry no meaning
A tracked module imports a file that git does not yet contain
